key_insight: Charge and orbital ordering is linked to the onset of hot-polaron photovoltaic response in layered Pr0.5Ca1.5MnO4 and PrCa2Mn2O7 thin films.
engineering_relevance: Controlling epitaxial strain and stacking faults may help tune ordering temperatures and photoelectric behavior in correlated-oxide junctions.
method: Grow epitaxial PrCa2Mn2O7 films by ion beam sputtering.
Compare with Pr0.5Ca1.5MnO4 films on (Nb:)SrTiO3 (110) substrates.
Characterize transport, optical absorbance, electronic bandstructure and temperature-dependent photovoltaic response.
evidence_signal: PrCa2Mn2O7 films exhibit an ordering transition at 320 K versus reported values up to 370 K, with increased stacking faults and lower ordering coherence than Pr0.5Ca1.5MnO4.
watch_item: Stacking faults are proposed, not conclusively established, as the cause of reduced ordering; the abstract reports no photovoltaic efficiency metrics or AI methods.
paper_title: Correlating orbital order and photovoltaic effect in Layered Ruddlesden-Popper Pr0.5Ca1.5MnO4 and PrCa2Mn2O7
